description: Each invoice's ratio is the mean of its line-level total-cost ÷ unit-price ratios.

c.request: For each invoice, look at its average line product cost (`derived_product_cost`) and its ratio of total cost (`derived_total_cost`) to unit price (`product_price`), ignoring missing values. Take the invoices whose ratio is above the average ratio across all invoices. In a single row, what are their average product cost, their average ratio, and on average how far their ratio sits above that overall average? No rounding. Each invoice's ratio is the mean of its line-level total-cost ÷ unit-price ratios.
c.sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(li.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(1.0 * li.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(li.product_price, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS overall_average_ratio FROM invoice_averages) SELECT AVG(ia.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(ia.average_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(ia.average_ratio - o.overall_average_ratio) AS average_amount_above_overall FROM invoice_averages AS ia CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ia.average_ratio > o.overall_average_ratio;

a.request: For each invoice (`Invoice_Line_Items.invoice_number`), take the average line product cost (`derived_product_cost`). Also take its total-cost-to-price ratio, found by dividing each line's `derived_total_cost` by its `product_price` and averaging those line ratios. Missing values are ignored. Average the invoice ratios across all invoices, and keep only the invoices whose ratio is above that average. As a single row, report the average over the kept invoices of (1) their average line product cost, (2) their ratio, and (3) how far their ratio exceeds the overall average ratio. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM invoice_stats) SELECT AVG(i.avg_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(i.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_excess FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg_ratio;

b.request: For each invoice, calculate the mean non-null `derived_product_cost` and the mean of its valid line-level `derived_total_cost` ÷ `product_price` ratios; select invoices whose mean ratio exceeds the mean ratio across all invoices, then return one row with the selected invoices’ mean invoice-level product cost, mean ratio, and mean amount by which their ratios exceed the overall mean, without rounding
b.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost) AS mean_product_cost, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.product_price, 0)) AS mean_ratio FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(mean_ratio) AS overall_mean_ratio FROM invoice_stats) SELECT AVG(s.mean_product_cost) AS mean_invoice_product_cost, AVG(s.mean_ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(s.mean_ratio - o.overall_mean_ratio) AS mean_ratio_excess FROM invoice_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.mean_ratio > o.overall_mean_ratio;

d.request: For each invoice, calculate the average `derived_product_cost` across its lines and the mean of its line-level `derived_total_cost` ÷ `product_price` ratios, ignoring missing values. Select invoices whose mean ratio exceeds the average invoice ratio across all invoices. In a single row, return their average product cost, average ratio, and average amount by which their ratio exceeds the overall average. Do not round.
d.sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(li.derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(1.0 * li.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(li.product_price, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS overall_average_ratio FROM invoice_averages) SELECT AVG(ia.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(ia.average_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(ia.average_ratio - o.overall_average_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio FROM invoice_averages AS ia CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ia.average_ratio > o.overall_average_ratio
